request.title: Reset your password
request.subtitle: Enter your email and we will send you a link to set a new password.
request.emailHint: The email you use to sign in.

sent.title: Check your email
sent.text: If an account exists for {{email}}, we sent it a link to reset the password.
sent.spam: The link works once. Check your spam folder if it does not arrive.

set.title: Set a new password
set.subtitle: After the change, every device is signed out.

invalid.title: Link not valid
invalid.text: This link has expired or was already used. Request a new link. If you already changed your password, sign in.

done.title: Password changed
done.text: Your password was changed and every device was signed out. Sign in with the new password.
